content: À ɗārǝ́ Dauda ɓǝ̀ duk murǝm mala Yahuda
Anzǝm mǝnia ka, Dauda ɗì Yahweh ama, <<Mǝ kya aɓa mwashat atà alá mala Yahuda le?>> Sǝ Yahweh banggi wi ama, <<Kyane.>> Dauda ɗiban ama, <<Ake sǝ mǝ ká?>> Yahweh banggi wi ama, <<A Hebǝron.>>
Pǝlǝa Dauda lo wari abanì andǝ amāmí gbal, Ahinoam ɓwama Jezǝril, andǝ Abigiyel mā-lú mala Nabal ɓwama Karmi.
Sǝ Dauda yinǝ aburana mǝnana à nda atè ka, koyan ngga andǝ amǝ'ɓala male; sǝ à duki arǝ alá mǝnana aɓa Hebǝron ngga.
Sǝ aburana mala Yahuda yiu a Hebǝron, sǝ à ɗārǝ́ Dauda ɓǝ̀ duk murǝm amur ɓala Yahuda. Lang à banggi Dauda ama, <<Aburana mala Jabesh-Gilǝyat na à tsǝklú Sawul ka,>>
Dauda tasǝ amǝ'na-túrbân nǝ cau aban aburana mala Jabesh-Gilǝyat ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ Yahweh tsǝka wun bù, ace pěmǝɓoarne mǝnia wu lǝmdǝì Sawul ɓwamǝgule ma'wun, nǝ tsǝkluí ka.
Ado ka, ɓǝ̀ Yahweh lǝmdǝa wun earcearǝu male mǝnana kǝ gǝshi raka, andǝ domǝsǝcau male. Sǝ mim gbal ka, mǝ nǝ pàkka wun mǝɓoarne ace gìr mǝnana wu pè ka.
Acemani ka, wu dum nǝ rǝcandǝa andǝ mǝsǝkàngkàngŋa, acemǝnana Sawul mǝtala-ɓala ma'wun ngga pàngŋǝ̀nà-lú, sǝ aɓwana mala Yahuda ɗārǝ́nam mǝ duk murǝm amúria.>>
Kúnɓuàna anre ɓala mala Dauda andǝ ɓala mala Sawul
Sǝama Abna muna-ɓwabura mala Ner, mǝ'sàrǝ̀ban mala amǝ'lwa mala Sawul ka, twal Ishboshet muna-ɓwabura mala Sawul sǝ yinǝi a Mahanayim.
Tsǝì duk murǝm amur abu-nzali Gilǝyat, andǝ Ashuri, andǝ Jezǝril, andǝ Ifǝrem andǝ Benjami andǝ Isǝrayila kat.
Ishboshet muna-ɓwabura mala Sawul ka, ndanǝ apǝlǝa lumi-ine lang à tsǝì duk murǝm amur Isǝrayila ka, sǝ yì ka pàk apǝlǝa ɓari a buno-murǝm. Sǝ ɓala mala Yahuda ka, kpata Dauda.
Sauwa mala bàkú mǝnana Dauda nda murǝm a Hebǝron amur ɓala mala Yahuda ka, apǝlǝa tongno-nong-ɓari andǝ azongŋo tongno-nong-mwashat na.
Abna muna-ɓwabura mala Ner, atārǝia andǝ aburana mala Ishboshet muna-ɓwabura mala Sawul ka, à lo a Mahanayim sǝ à o a Gibiyon.
Jowap muna-ɓwabura mala Zeruya
andǝ aburana mala Dauda puro sǝ à kya je andǝia a guguri mǝnana a Gibiyon ngga. Nggǝsan mwashat do a buì mala guguri man, sǝ ɓè nggǝsan ngga do a nkaring mala guguri.
Abna banggi Jowap ama, <<Ado ka, ɓǝ̀ sǝm tsǝk aɓea alaggana ma'sǝm ɓǝà pur ace munǝo, ɓwa andǝ ɓwa arǝarǝia, a ɓadǝm sǝm.>> Sǝ Jowap bang ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ à lo.>>
Nda à lo, à cam-nǝ-came sǝ à ɓallia; aburana lum-nong-ɓari a buì mala Benjami andǝ Ishboshet muna-ɓwabura mala Sawul, sǝ aburana lum-nong-ɓari a buì mala Dauda.
Koyanale ka bwal ɓì a ɓamúrí sǝ zuɓi nkanggari-bum ɓì nǝ byau male, sǝ à kpa nzali à wǔ atārǝia. Nda tsǝa sǝ mǝno yì ban a Gibiyon ngga, à tunǝi ama, Helkat-hazurim ngga.
Mǝsǝ munǝo bangŋa a pwari mǝno. Aburana mala Dauda gandǝ Abna andǝ aburana mala Isǝrayila.
Amuna-burana mala Zeruya tàrú, à nda abanì: Jowap, andǝ Abishai, sǝ Asahel. Asahel ka, mǝɓiki mire na kǝla mbamba a bondo.
Asahel pǝrta Abna, ɓinǝ kyang atà bui-mǝli ko mǝnggare, aban pǝrte.
Pǝlǝa Abna pǝlǝ mǝsǝi a nzǝmi sǝ na ama, <<A nda le, Asahel?>> Asahel ear ama, <<E, mǝ nda.>>
Abna banggi wi ama, <<Kyang atà buo mǝlì ko mǝnggare; gbami mwashat atà alaggana, sǝ wu ak agirbura male arǝì.>> Sǝ Asahel ka, ɗeki pǝrte ɗàng.
Nyare Abna sà'arǝ Asahel ama, <<Nying pǝrtam. Kǝa tsǝem ɓǝn wal-luio ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ ǝn wal-luio ka, lang sǝ mǝ nǝ sǝn mǝ'eambo Jowap a ɓamǝsǝi?>>

Sǝ Asahel ka, ɓinǝ kyangye. Nda Abna zuɓi a bumi nǝ tǝta nzo male ka. Nzoe kò kya pur a nzǝmi; Asahel kpa a nzali abanì sǝ wǔ a ɓadǝm Abna. Ɓwa mǝnana kat yiu a ban mǝnana Asahel kpa sǝ wù kam ngga, ɓwe cam gǝs.
Sǝ Jowap andǝ Abishai ka à pyangnǝata Abna. Lang pwari nǝ nggǝ ká kpa ka, à bwal ban mgbangban mala Ammah, tù a ban Giya, a njar ká ɓabondo Gibiyon.
Pǝlǝa aɓwana mala Benjami ram rǝia abanɓwáná anzǝm Abna, sǝ à cam amur mgbangban.

Pǝlǝa Abna tunǝ Jowap sǝ ɗì ama, <<Dumǝna púp sǝm nǝ̀ lidǝmba nǝ wal-lú rǝarǝ sǝm le? A sǝlǝ mbak ama nǝ̀ nggá duk mǝlulle a masǝlǝate? Nǝ̀ sau lang sǝ awu nǝ sà'arǝ aɓwana mô ɓǝà nying pǝrta amǝ'eambia?>>
Jowap eari wi ama, <<Kǝla mǝnana Ɓakuli na kam nǝyilǝmu ka, ɓǝ̀ a bangma cau man raka, mbak-kàngkàng aɓwana man pa nǝ̀ vwakibuia arǝ pǝrta amǝ'eambia ɗàng ba dǝmbari.>>
Nda Jowap twang njawe, sǝ aburane kat go-gǝs; à lidǝmba nǝ pǝrta Isǝrayila, ko à munǝ ɗǝm ɗàng.
Osso Abna andǝ aburana male gya nǝɓa Araba aɓa dù mǝno kat. À yàlî Nggeasala Jodan, sǝ à lidǝmba nǝ gya aɓa dǝmbari mǝno ba à yi bik Mahanayim.
Lang Jowap nyarǝnì pǝrta Abna ka, ramba amǝ'lwa male pupup abanɓwáná. Sǝni ka, aburana mala Dauda lum-bwamdǝ-tongno-nong-ine andǝ Asahel ka, à pà kàm ɗàng.
Sǝama aburana mala Dauda wal-lú aburana mala Benjami gbǝman-tàrú nǝ lumi-tongno-nong-mwashat mǝnana à nda atà Abna ka.
Jowap andǝ aburana male twal lú Asahel sǝ à kya tsǝî a ɓembe mala tarrí a Betalami. Pǝlǝa à gya aɓa dù kat sǝ à yi bwal Hebǝron a kwaro-la-ban.

footnotes.text: Zeruya ka ɓwama na, mǝ'nggaula Dauda.
Helkat-hazurim ngga ɓālǝi nda <<ɓatuli/nzawara mala akun-byau.>>
